$comment: Each entry in `screens` is one screenshot the user navigates to in the app
before running `pnpm filter=mobile screenshots:capture`. The capture script
frame-screenshots.mjs composites them into store-ready images per platform.
Captions are drafted from store/PLAY_LISTING.md + store.config.json — each
highlights one of the app's six listed features. Keep them under ~70 chars
so they wrap to two lines max at the framing font size.

screens.title: Past Bar Exams
screens.caption: 1,500+ Philippine Bar questions, 1953 to 2024.
screens.navHint: Open the Bar Exams tab and land on the year/subject browser.

screens.title: Case Digests
screens.caption: Supreme Court digests with provenance to the source.
screens.navHint: Open the digests LIST screen. Do NOT shoot the digest detail — its hero is a <Photo label="hero · digest" /> placeholder and pinned text renders illegibly across it.

screens.title: Codal Reader
screens.caption: Revised Penal Code, Labor Code, Civil Code in full.
screens.navHint: Library tab → Codals filter chip → "The Revised Penal Code" (Act No. 3815). Do NOT use the 1987 Constitution: it is in the corpus and published, but a document_type filter bug keeps it out of the Codals list. Verify on screen that whichever codal you pick actually renders before shooting. Expect the pre-existing section-segmentation off-by-one (each Article heading carries the NEXT article's body) — it affects every codal and is not introduced by the capture.

screens.title: AI Study Assistant
screens.caption: Grounded answers with citations — never fabricated.
screens.navHint: Use the IN-DOCUMENT READER CHAT — the ✨ button in the reader header, sheet titled "Ask this document" — NOT the Search AI Summary, which abstains on most substantive queries. Frame the answer body so an inline [n] citation AND the "Sources (n)" panel are both visible. READ THE ANSWER BEFORE CAPTURING: ask something the document answers outright ("When do the provisions of this Code apply outside the Philippines" works on the RPC); a question it cannot ground renders "Not enough grounding in this document to answer that."

screens.title: Camera Scan-to-Digest
screens.caption: Scan a printout. Get a structured digest.
screens.navHint: Open the Scan LANDING screen (Start Scan + real Recent Scans). Not a viewfinder — the simulator has no camera and staging one is itself a 2.3.3 violation.

screens.title: Search the Corpus
screens.caption: Cases, codals and digests in one search.
screens.navHint: Search tab → "constitution" → Top results showing CONSTITUTION, DECISION, EXECUTIVE ORDER and BAR EXAM QUESTIONS. Do NOT use "estafa": on the phone viewport it returns almost entirely BAR EXAM QUESTIONS, which contradicts the caption. Check the result-type labels before shooting — the caption promises mixed types.
